title: Постановочная драка друзей  (The Friends' Staged Brawl)

segments.t: Seeing how Lyova united the cooks against a common problem, Max comes up with one last plan to end Sasha and Nastya's feud. Right in front of the bar, Max and Kostya pretend to quarrel over their girlfriends and step outside for a staged fistfight.
Костян, у меня есть еще одна идея.
Нет, уж, знаешь, хватит с меня твоих идей.
Нормально? Ты что?
Конечно, кого еще?
Чего ты за своей бабой следи?
Чего ты не понял?
Может, выйдем?
Пока гости в соседний ресторан не сбежали.
Скажите, а вам не стыдно?
Ой, извините, я случайно.
Я просто...
Второй раз, да?
Да вас нужно опять вернуть в палату.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
Костян, у меня есть еще одна идея.
'Kostyan, I have one more idea.' Kostya reminds Max that someone he has one more idea before the moment passes.
Нет, уж, знаешь, хватит с меня твоих идей.
'No way, I have had quite enough of your ideas.' Because way he has had quite enough of Kostya's ideas, Max treats the matter as settled.
Нормально? Ты что?

'Are you okay with that? What is wrong with you?' Checking whether Max okay cuts straight through the tension between Kostya and Max. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Конечно, кого еще?
'Of course, who else?' With the kitchen and conversation hanging in the air, Max puts Kostya on the spot.
Чего ты за своей бабой следи?

'Why do you not keep an eye on your own woman?' Here asking why Max not keep an eye on Max's own woman shows Kostya looking for the real truth. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Чего ты не понял?
'What did you not understand?' By wondering what Kostya not understand, Max presses Kostya for a straight answer. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Может, выйдем?
'Maybe we should step outside?' Asking whether maybe they should step outside puts Max right on the defensive.
Пока гости в соседний ресторан не сбежали.
'Before the guests run off to the restaurant next door.' Over the problem and the moment, Max answers Kostya without a second thought.
Скажите, а вам не стыдно?

'Tell me, are you not ashamed of yourselves?' When Kostya asks if tell him are Max not ashamed of yourselves, Max has to answer fast. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
Ой, извините, я случайно.
'Oh, excuse me, that was an accident.' Even though that was an accident, Max keeps a steady face in front of Kostya.
Я просто...
'I was just...' Admitting that he was just shows Kostya being honest for a change.
Второй раз, да?

'A second time, really?' Over the moment and the problem, Max presses Kostya for a straight answer. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Да вас нужно опять вернуть в палату.

'We need to take you right back to your ward.' Here needing to take Max right back to Max's ward sets up the next turn in their exchange. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Костян, у меня есть еще одна идея.
Нет, уж, знаешь, хватит с меня твоих идей.
Нормально? Ты что?
Конечно, кого еще?
Чего ты за своей бабой следи?
Чего ты не понял?
Может, выйдем?
Пока гости в соседний ресторан не сбежали.
Скажите, а вам не стыдно?
Ой, извините, я случайно.
Я просто...
Второй раз, да?
Да вас нужно опять вернуть в палату.
That wraps up this scene as to make Nastya and Sasha stop fighting, Max convinces Kostya to stage a loud argument and fistfight between the two of them right in front of the girls. See you next time!
До свидания!
